name: support_triage
description: Customer support tickets: route to a team, rate frustration, flag urgency.

criteria.billing: Payment, invoice, refund, or subscription issues
criteria.technical: Bugs, errors, outages, or integration problems
criteria.sales: Pricing, plan upgrades, or new account questions

is_urgent.instructions: The message conveys urgency or time-sensitivity

cases.state: Hi, I've been trying to connect my Stripe account for 3 days and the integration keeps failing. I'm losing sales. Please help ASAP.
Could you send me a copy of last month's invoice? Our accountant needs it for the quarterly close sometime next week.
You charged my card TWICE this month. This is the second time this has happened. Refund me immediately or I'm disputing it with my bank today.
We're a 40-person team evaluating tools for next year. Do you offer volume discounts on the Business plan, and is annual billing available?
The export to CSV button doesn't do anything on Safari. Works fine in Chrome. Not a big deal, just wanted to let you know.
Your API has been returning 500s for the last hour and our entire checkout is down. This is completely unacceptable for a paid product. Fix it NOW.
I canceled my subscription two weeks ago but I was still charged. Kind of annoying, can someone look into it when you get a chance?
Our contract renews Friday and I need a quote for adding 15 more seats before then, otherwise procurement won't approve it this quarter.
Third time asking. The SSO login loops back to the sign-in page every time. I've cleared cookies, tried incognito, nothing works. Getting really tired of this.
What's the difference between the Pro and Business tiers? The pricing page doesn't really explain the API limits.
My payment keeps getting declined at checkout even though the card works everywhere else. I need access restored before my client demo in 2 hours.
This is a joke. Every update breaks something. Now the dashboard won't load at all. I'm telling everyone I know to avoid your garbage product.
